description: Canonical pass group IDs. A pass group coalesces N substrates sharing one coordinated painting pass into a single estimate line item. Read by engine, scenarios, tracker, and client portal.

groups.description: Walls and ceiling primed together in one continuous spray pass, pre-trim NC workflow. Triggered by project.default_combined_prime or room.combined_prime_override.
Walls and ceiling finished together in one pass when both substrates share system_id, product_id, sheen, and color_code.
